circuit_review.input_order: EXT_RAW -> F20 -> V_EXT_FUSED. D20 clamps V_EXT_FUSED to GND bidirectionally. Q20 drain on fused input and source on V_EXT_PROT gives body-diode startup in correct polarity and blocks reversed DC input. D21 cathode at source limits negative gate-to-source voltage; R20 pulls gate toward GND.
circuit_review.buck_uvlo: R21=127k and R22=20k give nominal divider gain 7.35. Datasheet EN high limits 1.16-1.36V and hysteresis 0.3-0.4V, including 1% resistor endpoints: startup approximately 8.38-10.17V, minimum turnoff approximately 5.49V, measured at BUCK_VIN after D22. Therefore 5V input cannot sustain the buck. Nominal 12V/24V supply tolerance and D22 drop must leave BUCK_VIN above the worst startup threshold. Terminal startup limits over temperature require prototype measurements.
circuit_review.output_capacitance_basis: TPSM365R6 RevC Table8-2 exact parts and section8.2.1.2.5: two C3225X7R1E226M250AB22uF25V X7R1210 parts yield approximately42uF effective at5V in TI example. Minimum required effective output capacitance is25uF. Approximate tolerance/temperature screen42*0.8*0.85=28.56uF; independent vendor ageing/DC-bias verification and physical ripple/load testing remain release gates.
circuit_review.transient_coordination: TVS 28V stand-off exceeds the 26.4V proposed operating ceiling. Its stated 45.4V clamp at 8.8A is below 60V P-FET/diode, 65V buck and 80V LDO limits; input ceramics are rated 100V. This is component-level coordination only. Temperature, parasitic overshoot, pulse energy, fuse clearing and source impedance remain unqualified. No sustained overvoltage or IEC immunity claim.
circuit_review.current_protection: F20 is0.5A63V fast fuse,50A interrupt rating; it protects against gross input faults, not a precise60mA limiter. Typical resistance0.517ohm (+/-25% at stated test condition). No automatic short/restart guarantee; burnt fuse means service/replacement. Use current-limited source during qualification.
circuit_review.thermal: At 26.4V, 10mA logic load and 450uA GND current, U21 dissipates approximately 0.243W. Reference 150C/W gives 36.5C temperature rise, not a qualified board temperature. No exposed pad; heat spreading uses pins and board. Initial 0-50C ambient target, 20mA LDO silicon rating and 600mA buck silicon rating are not measured assembly ratings.
circuit_review.input_cable: Start with short supply leads. TI recommends47-100uF electrolytic with0.1-0.4ohm ESR near module when long leads create input resonance. Local TVS and fuse resistance do not establish cable-inductance immunity; supplied lead configuration must pass ringing/startup tests, or damping must be added before release.
circuit_review.backfeed: Q20 is reverse-polarity protection, not an ideal diode; it does not block reverse current from a separately energised protected rail. No second power source is permitted on V_EXT_PROT. Selector-leg diode is separately owned and mandatory. U21 output must not be externally powered. No host-power connection is allowed.
circuit_review.ldo: U21 LT3014B has explicit reverse-output protection, resolving the former TPS7A16A VOUT<=VIN+0.3V input-collapse concern. R23=174k and R24=100k, both 0.1%, target 1.22*(1+1.74)=3.3428V before ADJ bias. R25=22k 1% ensures >100uA load. Full-temperature reference and resistor endpoints give approximately 3.229-3.457V before ADJ bias; the specified 25C maximum 10nA contributes 1.74mV. Full-temperature ADJ bias and actual low/high rail remain qualification gates.
circuit_review.buck_reverse: D22 isolates BUCK_VIN input bulk from a collapsed or shorted external rail. U20 VIN, R21 top, C20 and C21 connect to BUCK_VIN. Auto-mode diode emulation alone is not credited as off-state reverse protection. The selector diode separately blocks external or charged COM from V5_REG. Power-down and input-hard-short waveforms remain required.
